name: Radisson Blu Hotel Nagpur
why_special: 5-star on Wardha Road with the strongest cleanliness and service reviews in Nagpur — central for both Dr Ambedkar Airport (10 min) and city sightseeing. Outdoor pool, gym, breakfast spread widely cited. The default Nagpur pick for travellers heading on to Tadoba.

name: Le Méridien Nagpur
why_special: Marriott-Bonvoy 5-star with spacious rooms and an expansive lawn — strong for business-conference groups. 7 km from Nagpur airport. Spa, gym, La Brasserie all-day diner. The Marriott loyalty member's pick over the Radisson.

name: The Pride Hotel Nagpur
why_special: Pride Group 4-star directly opposite Nagpur airport — friendly mid-range service at 40–50% the Radisson Blu rate. The Nagpur pick when you need a clean comfortable business hotel without the 5-star markup, particularly for early Tadoba departures.

name: Tuli Imperial Nagpur
why_special: Local Tuli Group 4-star in Ramdaspeth — central for old Nagpur sightseeing (Deekshabhoomi, Zero Mile Marker) rather than the airport hotels. Multi-cuisine restaurant Tuli Imperial, popular with Marathi business travellers, the home-grown alternative to chain options.
